description: This file is a PHP source file for a web-based interface used to configure wireless network settings such as SSID, security mode, channels, and encryption methods. It includes server-side PHP code combined with client-side JavaScript for form validation and dynamic UI interactions. The content indicates it's part of a web UI for managing wireless network configurations on a gateway or router device.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from device root object using external function DmExtGetStrsWithRootObj and constructs an associative array with key-value pairs.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Displays a modal dialog for Wi-Fi security mode selection, allowing user to choose security options with validation.

methods.name: addslashes
methods.description: Escapes backslashes and double quotes in strings for safe inclusion in JavaScript or JSON.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Handles the form submission, gathers configuration data, and sends it via AJAX to server-side handler for saving wireless network settings.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Initiates a reset or restore action by sending configuration info via AJAX to server handler, then reloads page after progress indication.

methods.name: init_form
methods.description: Initializes form elements and UI states based on current device configuration and user permissions, including dynamic options and security settings.
